The Export button now works, and the fix is committed as `1a335e5`.

**Cause:** `OrdersPage.__init__` registered only the `refresh` handler. `click("export")` found no handler and did nothing. The existing test called `page.export()` directly, so it passed without exercising the button.

**Fix** (`src/orders-web/orders_page.py`): register `export` alongside `refresh`.

**Test** (`tests/test_orders_web.py`): added `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which goes through `click("export")`. I reasoned that it would fail before the fix, since no handler means no download, but I didn't run it against the old code.

The full suite passes with `python3 -m unittest` (9 tests).

I left your uncommitted README note and the `notes/` directory out of the commit. The note says to ask whether Export should include cancelled orders. The current export includes every order, so that question is still open.
